sections: Overview Dashboard: Revenue metrics, pending manual dispatches count, active currency exchange rates
Product Management: Add/edit products, manage specs (DOU+ coins, VIP cards), update stock/base prices
Order Management: Real-time order stream, status transition buttons ('開始充值', '確認人工發貨', '標記異常'), account details copy tool
Customer Service & Tickets: Live support chat simulation & ticket resolution
Exchange Rate Manager: Live adjustment of currency FX rates and markup margins
Promotions & Promo Code Manager: Create discount codes (e.g. 'GLOBAL2026')
Review Management: Moderation for customer reviews
User Management: View user accounts, order histories

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirements: Add data-testid to every button, input, card, menu item, currency tab, and modal trigger.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use React context or local state to store active currency, exchange rates, cart items, user session, and order history. Mock payment must create real order records in local storage or state so the admin panel can view and dispatch them.
instructions_to_main_agent.language_tone: Strictly use Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) for text content (e.g., 購物車, 立即購買, 充值帳號, 訂單狀態, 人工發貨, 優惠碼).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_rules: No generic centered slop. Make generous use of cards, clear grid gaps, micro-interactions with framer-motion, sonner toasts for feedback, and crisp high-contrast UI.
